mechanism: Albuterol's beta-2 agonist activity may potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular stimulation, while valbenazine's vesicular monoamine transporter 2 (VMAT2) inhibition could theoretically affect monoamine regulation.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and arrhythmias; use albuterol at lowest effective dose and consider alternative bronchodilators if excessive sympathomimetic effects occur.
